Magic 5-7, 1-4 on the road, -4.5 differential. The official 8:15 AM NBA report has Orlando without Paolo Banchero (right high ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Izaiyah Nelson (all OUT).

Live PA/MD price not checked.

Phoenix's injury report was NOT YET SUBMITTED at 8:15 AM. Phoenix won 4 of 6 before last night, including 102-99 over Houston. Starters not confirmed; Denver's starters are only inferred available from being off the report. FanDuel's Denver price drifted from -460 (8:00 AM EST) to -375 (9:00 AM EST) back to -390 (10:00 AM EST) and to -405 (12:00 PM EST) without a listed injury change, so the market still rates Denver less strongly than at the morning review. Live PA/MD price not checked.

research_holds.title: Nov 15 staged cards graded from official finals
research_holds.reason: Bills + Jaguars (posted 11:00 AM EST prices BUF -460 / JAX -700, 1.391x) WON: Bills 31, Jets 12; Jaguars 40, Titans 23 (ESPN finals). Spurs + Celtics (posted 3:00 PM EST prices SA -1200 / BOS -950, 1.197x) WON: Spurs 110, Jazz 102; Celtics 131, Mavericks 94 (ESPN finals). Nov 15 staged record: 2 wins, 0 losses. Running two-leg staged record Nov 9-15: 9 wins, 3 losses. These are staged research cards, not recorded wagers. Lessons: both road favorites with winning records against losing home teams pulled away in the second half after close first halves (JAX led 13-10 and BUF 10-3 late in the 2nd quarter); the Spurs won by only 8 without Fox and Harris (58-55 at halftime) against a depleted 1-12 Jazz, so a late starter downgrade on the favorite narrowed the margin even when the opponent was missing more; Boston at home vs a back-to-back Dallas missing Irving was never close.

Very short prices add little payout and do not remove upset risk, so a single heavy-favorite leg is not a lock.
